lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCuAg adopts the trigonal R-3m (No. 166) space group, with a unit cell containing 9 atoms—Mg3Cu3Ag3—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Cu and Mg each surrounded by 8 Ag and 4 Cu/Mg neighbors, and Ag by 6 Cu and 6 Mg neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 9 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that Cu and Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra share corners and edges, while Cu–Cu and Mg–Mg polyhedra share corners and faces.
